claims: VCU Rams is the Virginia Commonwealth University men’s basketball team.
VCU Rams men’s basketball team is an NCAA Division I program.
VCU Rams men’s basketball team is in the Atlantic 10 Conference.
VCU Rams men’s basketball team is based in Richmond, Virginia.
VCU Rams men’s basketball team had a 2026 NCAA Tournament appearance.
VCU Rams men’s basketball team had a 2011 Final Four run.
VCU Rams men’s basketball team defensive style is nicknamed "Havoc".
11-seed VCU Rams made the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
VCU Rams defeated 6-seed North Carolina 82-78 in overtime in the first round of the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
VCU Rams lost to Illinois in the second round of the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
VCU Rams won 28 games in the 2025-26 season.
VCU Rams had an Atlantic 10 Tournament appearance in the 2025-26 season.
2025-26 VCU Rams roster featured Lazar Djokovic.
2025-26 VCU Rams roster featured Barry Evans.
2025-26 VCU Rams roster featured Nyk Lewis.
2025-26 VCU Rams roster featured Brandon Jennings.
2025-26 VCU Rams roster featured Jadrian Tracey.
VCU Rams plays home games at the Stuart C. Siegel Center in Richmond.
